_doc: Default settings. Copy this file to ~/.claude/anchor-review/config.json and edit it to customize; any key you leave out falls back to this file. Every value here was chosen by the skill author for ACL × RAG and is only a starting point.
field: retrieval-augmented generation, context compression, multi-hop QA, long-context robustness

criteria_building._doc: Phase 1: analyze papers with known outcomes and write per-tier criteria. Classes are outcome groups; counts are how many papers to collect and analyze per class.

class_venues.MAIN: ACL / EMNLP / NAACL main conference, last 2 years
class_venues.FINDINGS: Findings of ACL / EMNLP / NAACL, last 2 years
class_venues.COLING: COLING main conference (accepted at the lower-tier venue)
class_venues.ARXIV-ONLY: arXiv preprints 14–30 months old with no publication record

criteria_building._criteria_dir_doc: Shipped default criteria (ACL tiers x RAG field, built from 42 known-outcome papers). Write your own to ~/.claude/anchor-review/criteria/<name>/ and point here.

review._doc: Phase 2: one blind bundle; every reviewer reads every paper; a paper's score is the mean over reviewers.
review.reviewers: one per tier in tiers_file[target_venue] (default: target ACL, peer EMNLP, lower COLING)
